key_point: He deleted his own hit game
title: He deleted his own hit game
caption: Flappy Bird's creator removed it at its peak because he felt the game had become too addictive. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #flappybird #mobilegames

instagram.caption:
In early 2014, Flappy Bird was the most downloaded free game, reportedly earning around $50,000 a day.

Its solo creator Dong Nguyen hated the attention. He tweeted that he could not take it anymore and pulled the game.

He said it had become an addictive product and he felt guilty. Phones with it installed later sold online for crazy prices.

Would you have deleted it?
